name: TSU Bridge (Whatnot)
description: TSU unified v3.2.0 - sales/overlay bridge PLUS the chat bot in one package. v3.4.1 (2026-09-22) stops an unresolvable listing being reprocessed every poll - it is now parked in the dedup map until the seller retitles it, which also restores the pagination early-stop. v3.4.0 (2026-09-21) ROOT CAUSE: React _valueTracker was never reset, so React never registered the typed text and the send handler bailed on an empty message - chat now filled via execCommand insertText with a tracker-reset fallback. Also narrows the giveaway start detector, which was firing on tab-open. v3.3.0 adds failure reporting to the bridge (bot_error / bot_diag / bot_giveaway_signal) because every real failure was console-only and bot_event was logged on ATTEMPT, not on delivery. v3.2.0 FIXES timed messages, which never fired: the MV3 service worker holds timer specs in memory, Chrome kills it after ~30s idle, so by the time a 2-minute alarm fired the payload was gone and onAlarm returned silently. Specs now live in chrome.storage.session. The chat bot half stays dormant unless the client is provisioned for it in Supabase, so enabling the bot later needs NO reinstall.
